review_description: The process was smooth. Installation happened as promised. The installers were polite and helpful. Now waiting for smart meter to be installed so not yet fully operational.

Excellent service all round. Very efficient with the whole process from quoting to installation. Very professional with a high grade product and a great working team. Would definitely recommend them to anyone needing a quality product and an efficient and professional installation. Back up service is exceptional.

He was the only one out of 4 that did research on my existing system and explained what I could and couldn't do, example could I marry up the systems with 1 inverter or did I need 2 what was needed to be battery compatible. He addressed what I wanted explained problems then gave me options, including of course what he considered best.

Very wide price differences in the quotes.I went with a local supplier over the Sydney supplier even though the price was significantly higher mainly because I wanted to sit with the supplier and understand thepros/cons of each option.Having a local to provide service on the system was/is also important to me.The hard sell approach from the Sydney supplier also put me on the defensive from the start.  They had proposed a system without looking at my setup, electricity usage or base requirements.

I did look into the quotes you sent and thank you for that. I then looked at some local recommendations and got more quotes.Brett was very helpful and explained things very clearly.I had three other quotes which he was able to beat and his installation and panels were top quality. I am happy to recommend him for other customers.
